Services

Practical engineering help for teams that need to move fast without breaking things.

What I help with

  • DevOps & CI/CD
    • GitHub Actions/Jenkins/GitLab CI pipelines, environments, and release flows
    • Secure supply chain (SBOM/signing), staging/prod parity, artifact strategy
  • Cloud Architecture (AWS)
    • Scalable VPC/ALB/ECS/EKS designs, multi-AZ hardening, IaC (Terraform)
    • Networking, routing, secrets, KMS/S3, CloudFront + WAF
  • Kubernetes
    • EKS/ECS app onboarding, Helm/Kustomize, autoscaling, service mesh readiness
    • Runtime security basics, policies, image strategy, blue/green & canary
  • SRE & Observability
    • SLOs/error budgets, incident response, on-call ergonomics
    • Logs/metrics/traces (CloudWatch/OpenTelemetry/Prometheus/Grafana)
  • Cost & Reliability Reviews
    • FinOps quick wins—right-sizing, autoscaling, caching, storage classes
    • Failure testing, graceful degradation, CDN/error-handling patterns
  • AI & Automation for Engineering
    • Lightweight agent/prompt patterns for internal tooling
    • “Glue” automations for CI/CD, incident triage, and ops hygiene
